_description: Agency-level registry of every client repo — one entry per client. Written by scripts/onboard-client.ts at client onboarding time, NOT by the integration lead agent — a client's repo (and its deployed secrets, including the shared GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY) exists from the moment onboarding creates it, which is before design-agent, backend-agent, or QA ever run, let alone integration-lead at final signoff. Registering only at signoff would leave every client mid-build invisible to the rotation runbook (see .claude/agents/backend-agent.md, 'Rotation runbook') for the entire build duration — exactly the scenario this file exists to prevent. integration-lead-agent reads this file (vercel_project_id to know which Vercel project to query, github_installation_id to know which GitHub App installation to push the final QA-passed code through — see 'Assumption' in integration-lead-agent.md for why pushing happens there and not earlier) but never writes it; a missing entry there means onboarding was skipped, and integration-lead flags that rather than silently registering one itself. Each entry: {client_id (matches that client's own .pipeline/*.json client_id), name, repo_url, vercel_project_id, github_installation_id, added_at (ISO date), added_by}.
